set.body: Acceptance criteria: every finite-direction projected Wasserstein constructor returns no stronger than Semimetric unless injectivity is proven for its admitted domain; direction configuration is validated at construction; the one-direction orthogonal-mass counterexample is retained; all successful configurations satisfy their advertised reusable laws; MeasureDistance, Similarity, MultiMatchScore, caller-supplied costs, numerical floors, and transport solver parameters receive the weakest truthful validated contracts; no default-only law run certifies a broader constructor space.
set.title: Make projected Wasserstein and comparison scores law-honest
